summary: Speeds up verified workspace entry and makes project member access easier to read.
userImpact: The dashboard can show results as soon as the workspace reads finish for platform administrators.
Text can appear while the bundled IBM Plex fonts load.
Project member dialogs show names when available and keep assignment diagnostics out of tenant users' view.
security: Workspace access still requires matching authenticated session context and permission checks.
documentation: Release notes describe the dashboard startup check, font loading, and project role visibility.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding compatible frontend image.
validation: Frontend unit tests preserve the setup guard for standalone deployments and delegated administrators.
Chromium and Firefox open and reload an authenticated pooled workspace with no duplicate setup request.
Project member dialog tests cover named role assignments and visibility of diagnostics.
Compared cold sign-in text paint in production builds with delayed IBM Plex fonts.

customerDocumentation.reason: The improvement requires no user or administrator action.
